geometryMethod: Actual runtime footprint RECT/ELLIPSE/POLYGON pads transformed to top-copper Y-up; native LINE/ARC route width buffer, all-layer VIA disks, actual +3V3 In2 FILL contour containment. ARC stroking0.5deg segments; rounded buffers finite mesh. Local contact comparisons tolerance0.00001mil; exact line/via and resistor straight-edge gaps analytical to numericalprecision.
limitations: No actual deletion, rename, component move, library mutation or native API operation performed.
A10-LINE deletion isolates bias pads electrically but is not clearance-clean at R164 until its dedicated power VIA is removed/relocated or geometry adjusted.
Do not simply rename any feed or its VIA: these VIAs contact existing global+3V3 In2 plane and require real physical rework/plane clearance.
Global power planes, MCU fanout and all non-target records are protected; no need to edit them for these ten feed cuts.
This bounded plan does not reroute bias supply, validate PRE bypass removal, place new ICs, refill planes, replace native DRC, or approve fabrication.
